moworks.notes: Idea and numbers (TakayuStudio grid-center, written here): 3×3 tiles by ring: centre first, the 4 edge tiles 70 ms later, the 4 corners at 140 ms. Each starts 22 px closer to the centre at scale 0.3 and moves out to its cell at scale 1 in 720 ms back.out (bezier .34,1.56,.64,1), opacity in over the first 40 % (860 ms in all). Two guide rings pulse at the ring delays (not ported). Params: pull: lệch về tâm (22 px) · scale đầu (0.3) · ring: trễ mỗi vòng (70 ms) · each (0.72 s).
